facts.fact: The Monitor reports ECCMIS, the judiciary's electronic court case management system for registration, management and reporting, had been rolled out to at least 31 courts in the Greater Kampala region as of February 2026.

The Monitor reports ECCMIS allows 24/7 electronic case filing with online payment of court fees through URA integration, and a Chief Justice circular of 17 February 2026 requires all filings in ECCMIS courts to be electronic from 1 June 2026.
